The sounds in Data\Sound\fo4bowling are cut from real bowling alley recordings on Freesound, all released under
CC0 1.0 (public domain). They were converted to mono 44.1 kHz, trimmed, faded, de-hissed and levelled for the mod.

  crash_1, hit_1, release_1
      "Bowling Ball Hits Pins, Once" by CHallSmith
      https://freesound.org/people/CHallSmith/sounds/870830/
  crash_2, crash_3, hit_2, hit_3, hit_4
      "B_2 Bowling ball striking pins" by Yarmonics (Stuart Bowditch), Great Yarmouth
      https://freesound.org/people/Yarmonics/sounds/441856/
  roll_1, release_2
      "Bowling Ball.wav" by driftworks
      https://freesound.org/people/driftworks/sounds/128969/
  pin_*
      "bowling pins mono" by Bruce Burbank
      https://freesound.org/people/Bruce%20Burbank/sounds/151203/
